description: Like event_study, for a move of an index found in our prices: index SPY (S&P 500), QQQ (Nasdaq-100) or HSI (Hang Seng Index) moving pct percent (signed: -10 = a fall of 10% or more) within days trading days (a fall without days = from its high). Use for 'what happens if the Nasdaq drops 10% in two days' or 'what does Hong Kong do after the S&P 500 falls 3% in a day' (market HK).
